title: Murder of Gauri Lankesh
narrative: FIR — Murder of Gauri Lankesh, Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka. On 5 September 2017, Gauri Lankesh, a journalist and editor known as a critic of right-wing Hindu extremism, was shot dead with a pistol by a helmeted assailant in the driveway of her home. The Special Investigation Team identified Parashuram Waghmare as the shooter and Amol Kale among the masterminds, linking the conspiracy to a radical organisation. Eighteen people were arrested and charged in the case.
